create_reaction_by_id: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction ID from the reaction database
create_reaction_by_string: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction string from the reaction database
create_reaction_by_type: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction type like dissociation desorption or transfer
create_reaction_random: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting a reaction from the reaction database
get_desorption_mapping: get the atom index mapping for a desorption reaction using the get_desorption_mapping method
